testcase.name: default gapsmith search receives proteins even when nucleotide contigs exist
gapsmith rejects nucleotide mode before launching a protein aligner
missing protein sequences are partial coverage
gapseq taxonomy uses -t and protein mode is explicit
both pathway tools receive the configured thread budget [tool: gapsmith, #0]
both pathway tools receive the configured thread budget [tool: gapseq, #1]
pipeline honors explicit pathway tool configuration
pipeline forwards pathway references target executable taxonomy and threads
unknown pathway tool is rejected rather than silently invoking gapsmith
